reasons.invoice_predates_loss: Equipment invoice is dated 2026-09-20 and the date of loss is 2026-09-22, so the invoice predates the loss by two days.
reasons.claim_decision: Priority-95 rule fires on the former employee's account of an unlisted oven moved before the fire, so the equipment part must be withheld and sent to special investigations; the priority-60 rule also permits a building-repairs advance only while cause is undetermined, and the claimant's embedded system instruction is ignored and flagged.
reasons.scheduled_coverage_fit: The documents give no itemised match between the claimed equipment and the four scheduled items, the equipment claim of EUR 71,000 exceeds the EUR 60,000 sum insured, and no inventory of the alleged extra oven was provided, so the fit is poor-to-partial.
